propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute a single dry-run differ pass and emit one manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift detail from that same pass without launching reconcile-check separately.
Canonical preview must operate lock-free: it acquires, purges, steals, and writes no pass lock, and all collateral repository/ref/binding/snapshot/diagnostic state must remain unchanged.

The argparse parser must set allow_abbrev=False to reject undocumented prefix abbreviations (e.g. --dry-run interpreted as --dry-run-enumerate) before any store access or lock ceremony, while documented options like --mode dry-run remain valid.

Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check retains its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free diagnostic JSON output, and distinct behavior independent of the canonical preview changes.

Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit field-comparable manifest envelopes with the same keys; canonical uncapped live must retain a manifest with exact applied/failed tallies while legacy uncapped LIVE callers keep the historical tally-only/no-manifest contract.

Existing capped canonical sync, legacy bootstrap applied/deferred partitions, and all legacy CLI/library/MCP/workflow callers must retain their historical observable behavior and output surface unchanged.
